name: blob-solutions/woocommerce-vcr-am-i18n-bin
description: Isolated composer-bin context for wp-cli's i18n command, which extracts the translation template and compiles the catalogues. Kept out of the main require-dev so wp-cli's dependency tree cannot constrain Pest or PHPStan. Both versions are exact: this context has no committed lock, the template records the generator's version, and `bin/i18n check` compares the template byte for byte, so a newer extractor on a CI runner would fail a tree whose strings did not change.
